title: [Shopify] Optimize unmapped cue counts
summary: Shopify cue counts for unmapped items now use stored SystemId fields and a new key to enable efficient SQL queries instead of materializing tables row by row during Role Center refresh.
key_points: Changed cue calculations to count empty Customer and Item SystemId fields instead of using lookup FlowFields
SQL can now execute direct COUNT(*) queries instead of materializing source tables
Added a new key led by Item SystemId for efficient global unmapped-product seeking
Records with deleted Customer or Item references are no longer included in counts
